from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u065/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = next(c for c, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 2)
    out = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        if r <= center:
            out[r][center - r] = 2
            out[r][center + r] = 2
        for c in range(n):
            if (c - r - center) % 4 == 0:
                if r > center or center - r < c < center + r:
                    if out[r][c] == 0:
                        out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
